svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Trade routes to and from Balaghat
svg.desc: A world map centred on Balaghat in Madhya Pradesh, India. Solid lines run outward to export destinations in Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, Africa, Bangladesh, South East Asia, South Korea and Japan. Dashed lines run inward from manganese ore sources in South Africa, Gabon and Australia.
